# k0rdent_vpc_peering (Data Source)

One VPC peering, by name, read rather than managed.

A peering joins two VPCs, and a VPC comes with a cluster or an instance group rather than being created directly, so the two sides of a peering routinely belong to different configurations. This is how the side that did not create it sees whether it is established.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One VPC peering by name, under one of its VPCs. Warns if it isn't active.

data "k0rdent_vpc_peering" "to_shared_services" {
  id  = "training-to-shared"
  vpc = "training-vpc"
}

check "peering_is_up" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.k0rdent_vpc_peering.to_shared_services.state == "active"
    error_message = "The peering to ${data.k0rdent_vpc_peering.to_shared_services.remote_vpc} is ${data.k0rdent_vpc_peering.to_shared_services.state}, so nothing routes across it yet."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The peering's name. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `vpc` (String) The VPC the peering is read from. A peering is addressed under one of its two VPCs. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `local_vpc` (String) The VPC this peering is defined on.
- `remote_vpc` (String) The VPC on the other side.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this object.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. `active` means traffic is carried.
- `state_message` (String) The platform's own explanation of the state.
- `tags` (Map of String) User-defined labels, as key-value pairs.
